name: The Wild Titan

source.note: The Crooked Moon (Legends of Avantris), appendix A. Numbers are the book's; the words are ours. Lair XP is 41,000 (the block lists 33,000 outside it). Its type is Giant (Titan); the engine has no subtype key, so it is tagged.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (4/Day, or 5/Day in Lair)
traits.summary: 4 times a day (5 in its lair), a failed saving throw becomes a success.
traits.text: When it fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead, 4 times a day or 5 times in its lair.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.summary: Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Runic Sever
traits.summary: Starting its turn within 50 ft of a stone at least 10 ft high and wide carved with its forgotten creator's glyph: it takes 50 Necrotic and is Poisoned until the start of its next turn.
traits.text: If the titan starts its turn within 50 feet of a stone at least 10 feet high and 10 feet wide that bears the glyph of its forgotten creator, it takes 50 Necrotic damage and is Poisoned until the start of its next turn.

traits.name: Siege Monster
traits.summary: Double damage against objects and structures.

traits.name: Regional Lair Effects
traits.summary: While it lives and keeps its lair, the land round it carries two effects: Whiteout; Wild Hunger.
traits.text: Whiteout: within 1 mile of the lair there is a 75 percent chance each day of heavy precipitation. Wild Hunger: within 1 mile of the lair creatures are always ravenous; a creature finishing a Long Rest there makes a DC 15 Con save or gains 1 Exhaustion level (creatures that don't eat succeed). Both end at once if the titan dies or moves its lair.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.summary: Two Massive Fist attacks; either or both can be a Thrown Boulder instead.

actions.name: Massive Fist
actions.summary: +17, reach 20 ft, 4d8+10 Bludgeoning; a Huge or smaller target is Grappled and Restrained (escape DC 20, two fists).
actions.text: A hammering fist: 28 (4d8 + 10) Bludgeoning damage. A Huge or smaller target is Grappled (escape DC 20) in one of its two fists and Restrained until it escapes.

actions.name: Thrown Boulder
actions.summary: Hurls a boulder at a point within 150 ft: 10-ft-radius sphere, DC 25 Dex save, 4d6 Bludgeoning and Prone (half damage on a success).
actions.text: It throws a boulder at a point it can see within 150 feet. Each creature in a 10-foot-radius sphere there makes a DC 25 Dexterity save, taking 14 (4d6) Bludgeoning damage and falling Prone on a failure, or half damage on a success.

actions.name: Wild Roar

params.attack: its most powerful melee or ranged attack

actions.summary: Recharge 5-6. Every enemy within 100 ft makes a DC 19 Wis save or is Charmed until the titan's next turn and must use its action to attack the nearest creature it can see.
actions.text: A roar that sets the wilds loose. Each of the titan's enemies within 100 feet makes a DC 19 Wisdom save. On a failure the creature is Charmed until the start of the titan's next turn, and while Charmed it must use its action to make its most powerful melee or ranged attacks against the nearest creature it can see.

actions.name: Arm Sweep
actions.summary: Legendary only, once a round. 20-ft cone, DC 25 Dex save, 2d8 Bludgeoning and Prone (half damage on a success).
actions.text: A sweeping arm: each creature in a 20-foot cone makes a DC 25 Dexterity save, taking 9 (2d8) Bludgeoning damage and falling Prone on a failure, or half damage on a success. Not again until the titan's next turn begins.

actions.name: Crushing Hurl
actions.summary: Legendary only, once a round. Hurls a held object, a creature it grapples, or a Large clod of earth up to 100 ft: DC 25 Dex save for everything in the landing space, 2d8+10 Bludgeoning and Prone (half on a success).
actions.text: The titan throws something it is holding, a creature it has grappled, or a large clod of earth to a space within 100 feet. Each creature in that space, the hurled one included, makes a DC 25 Dexterity save, taking 19 (2d8 + 10) Bludgeoning damage and falling Prone on a failure, or half damage on a success. Not again until the titan's next turn begins.

options.name: Arm Sweep
options.summary: 20-ft cone, DC 25 Dex save: 2d8 Bludgeoning and Prone. Once a round.

options.name: Crushing Hurl
options.summary: Hurls what it holds, a grappled creature or a clod of earth up to 100 ft: DC 25 Dex save, 2d8+10 Bludgeoning and Prone. Once a round.

options.name: Stomping Stride
options.summary: Moves up to its Speed without Opportunity Attacks, and can enter a Huge or smaller creature's space, pushing that creature to the nearest free space.

summary: A mountain-sized giant of the wilds: it pins heroes in fists with 20 ft of reach, hurls boulders, hurls its captives, and its roar turns a party on itself.
